summary: Creates cuboid geometry or, when connected to an input, generates a box that bounds the incoming geometry.

key_params.name: orientbounds
key_params.note: Rotate the bounds box to match the input SOP orientation

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Enable transform parameters to adjust input-derived bounds

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Box size along X, Y, and Z

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: X anchor point for positioning, scale, and rotation

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Y anchor point for positioning, scale, and rotation

key_params.name: anchorw
key_params.note: Z anchor point for positioning, scale, and rotation

key_params.name: divs
key_params.note: Division count on X, Y, and Z

common_gotchas: With an input connected, size and transform parameters modify a bounds result rather than an independent primitive.
Orient Bounds only matters for input-derived bounds.
For dense editable meshes or deformations, a Box SOP may need subdivision or conversion downstream.
Divided boxes create open polygons rather than a closed-face solid.
Consolidating corners changes point topology and can affect downstream point operations.
key_concepts: Box SOP creates cuboid geometry or, with an input, a box representing the incoming geometry bounds.
Transform and anchor parameters modify either the generated primitive or the input-derived bounds depending on connection state.
Divisions create editable open polygonal sections rather than a single closed solid mesh.
Texture-coordinate modes and normal generation are built into the box primitive workflow.
